enhanced.enhanced_prompt:
Build a pricing page for a design tool targeting AI/ML engineers, technical product teams, and creative professionals who value sophisticated infrastructure and research-driven solutions.

Platform: Website (Desktop: 992px-1440px+, Tablet: 768px-991px, Mobile: 0-767px)
Visual Tone: Brutalist meets corporate—monochromatic, technical, research-lab aesthetic with stark contrast and minimal decoration
Layout Constraints: 12-column grid, 2rem gutter, 90rem max-width; centered symmetric layout with generous 9rem vertical padding (4rem mobile); single-column mobile collapse

COLORS
Background Surfaces: Deep black #1E1E1E for dark sections, off-white cream #F5F7F2 for light sections, pure white #FFFFFF for card surfaces, extra dark #111111 for footer/product zones
Primary Text: #1E1E1E (Ink Black) on light backgrounds, #F5F7F2 (Paper White) on dark backgrounds
Interactive Accent: Raw web blue #0000EE (System Blue) for links and brand touchpoints—the unmistakable brutalist hyperlink aesthetic
Secondary Text: #8B8B8B (Slate Gray) for de-emphasized copy, supporting descriptions, captions
Borders: 1px solid #0000000D (5% black) on light surfaces, 1px solid #FFFFFF0D (5% white) on dark surfaces, 1px solid #CCCCCC for form inputs

TYPOGRAPHY
Hero Headline: Matter TRIAL, font-weight 700, size var(--hero-size), line-height 1.02
Section Headline: Azeret Semimono, clamp(2.5rem, 4vw, 4rem), line-height 1.2em, font-weight 400
Plan Titles: Matter, clamp(2rem, 3vw, 2.2rem), line-height 1.2em, font-weight 400
Feature Lists: Matter, clamp(1rem, 1.05vw, 1.1rem), line-height 1.5em, font-weight 300
Pricing Numbers: Azeret Semimono for technical credibility
Button/CTA Text: Azeret Semimono, clamp(0.8125rem, 0.9vw, 0.9375rem), line-height 1.4em, font-weight 400
Form Labels/Inputs: Matter, 16px, line-height 1.2, font-weight 400

SPACING & GRID
Section Padding: 9rem vertical (desktop), 4rem (mobile)
Grid Gutter: 2rem (desktop/tablet), 1.5rem (mobile)
Card Internal Padding: 3rem-4rem
Element Separation: Use 2rem-3rem between major blocks, 1rem-1.5rem between related elements

SHADOWS & ELEVATION
Card Shadow: 0 0 0 1px #0000001a, 0 1px 3px #0000001a (subtle border ring + lift)
Focus Ring: 0 0 0 5px #19F (accessibility indicator on interactive elements)
No heavy drop shadows—rely on borders and stark color blocking for elevation

BORDERS & DIVIDERS
Section Dividers: 1px solid #747370 (Slate Gray) horizontal strokes between pricing tiers
Card Borders: 1px solid #0000000D on light backgrounds, 1px solid #FFFFFF0D on dark backgrounds
Active Plan Border: 5px solid #002BBA (Blue Primary) or 5px solid #E2E2E2 for selected state indicators

SURFACES & GRADIENTS
Hero Background Overlay: linear-gradient(#fff0, #00000040) over background video/image
Section Transitions: linear-gradient(0deg, #1e1e1e, #fff0 30%, #4e4e4e00 80%, #1e1e1e 90%) for smooth color-block transitions between black and light sections
Glassmorphism (if nav bar): backdrop-filter: blur(30px); background-color: #0F1011 with transparency

BUTTONS
Primary CTA ("Try the API", "Get in touch"): transparent background, #F5F7F2 text, 1px solid #F5F7F2 border, padding 0.43rem 2rem, rounded corners; hover inverts to #F5F7F2 background with #1E1E1E text
Text Link CTA ("Explore code", "Compare plans →"): transparent background, #F5F7F2 text on dark or #8B8B8B on light, no border; hover opacity 0.5
Ghost Button: Same as primary CTA but more subtle, used for secondary actions

INTERACTIONS & ANIMATIONS
Page Transition: @keyframes tastePageIn { from { opacity: 0; } to { opacity: 1; } } — fade-in on load
Button Hover: transition: all 0.2s for background/color changes
Nav Link Hover: transition: all 0.3s with opacity change, JS-driven GSAP underline scale effect
Tab Transitions: transition: background-color 200ms ease, color 200ms ease
Modal/Overlay: transition: all 0.2s linear for fade effects

PRICING CARD SPECS
Card Background: #FFFFFF on dark sections, #FBFBFB on light sections
Card Border: 1px solid #0000000D (light) or #FFFFFF0D (dark)
Active/Featured Plan: 5px solid #002BBA border-left or border-top to emphasize
Plan Name: Azeret Semimono, uppercase, 12px, font-weight 500, letter-spacing tracked
Price Display: Azeret Semimono for numbers, Matter for "/month" descriptor, clamp(2rem, 3vw, 2.2rem) for price figure
Feature List: Matter body text, clamp(1rem, 1.05vw, 1.1rem), checkmarks or minimal line-art icons in #8B8B8B
CTA in Card: "Try for free →" or "Get in touch" button using primary CTA style

FORM INPUTS (if contact/trial signup)
Input Background: #FBFBFB on light sections, #171717 on dark sections
Input Border: 1px solid #CCCCCC, focus state 5px solid #002BBA
Input Text: Matter, 16px, line-height 1.2, font-weight 400, color #1E1E1E or #F5F7F2
Validation Icons: Line-art SVG (check-circle for success, alert-circle for error) in currentColor
Form Notification Background: #EFEEEC with 10% opacity overlay

ICONS
Use minimal line-art SVG icons: arrow-up-right for external links, check-circle for included features, alert-circle for warnings
Icon Size: 16px (small), 24px (medium)
Icon Color: currentColor to inherit text color, #8B8B8B for de-emphasized states

DIVIDERS & STRUCTURE
Horizontal Dividers: 1px solid #747370 between pricing tiers or FAQ sections
Vertical Dividers: 1px solid #0000000D or #FFFFFF0D between columns in comparison tables

COMPARISON TABLE (if included)
Table Background: Alternating rows with #FBFBFB and #FFFFFF on light sections, #1E1E1E and #111111 on dark
Table Borders: 1px solid #0000000D (light) or #FFFFFF0D (dark)
Header Row: Azeret Semimono, font-weight 500, uppercase, 12px
Cell Text: Matter, clamp(0.9rem, 1vw, 1rem), line-height 1.3em, font-weight 300
Checkmarks: Minimal line-art icon or Azeret Mono "✓" character in #002BBA

ACCESSIBILITY
Focus States: 0 0 0 5px #19F ring on all interactive elements
Color Contrast: Ensure WCAG AA minimum—#1E1E1E on #F5F7F2, #F5F7F2 on #1E1E1E, #002BBA links on both
Keyboard Navigation: Visible focus indicators, logical tab order through pricing tiers and CTAs

BRUTALIST HYPERLINK AESTHETIC
All text links use raw #0000EE (System Blue) with underline, referencing default HTML hyperlinks for technical credibility
No hover color change—only opacity shift or underline animation to maintain brutalist raw feel

SECTION RHYTHM
Alternate between deep black (#1E1E1E) hero, off-white (#F5F7F2) comparison section, pure white (#FFFFFF) FAQ, extra dark (#111111) footer
Use gradient overlays at transitions: linear-gradient(0deg, #1e1e1e, #fff0 30%, #4e4e4e00 80%, #1e1e1e 90%)
Generous 9rem vertical padding (desktop) creates breathing room and cinematic pacing
